'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Oman]]
***[[Iran]] attacks [[ship navigation]] systems on [[Didamar Island]], [[Oman]]. Unknown damage is caused. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-attacks-shipping-navigation-systems-omans-didamar-island-sources-say-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Attacks on health facilities during the Gaza war]]
***[[Israel]] launches an [[airstrike]] against the [[Nasser Medical Complex]] in [[Khan Younis]], killing six [[Palestinians]], including a surgeon, and wounding over 20 more. Four more people are also killed in other airstrikes in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/11/israeli-strikes-hit-tent-camp-as-five-killed-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-southern-gaza-hospital-kills-four-gaza-civil-defence-says-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency (2007-present)|Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]], [[Ituri war (2017–present)|Ituri war]]
**At least 22 people are killed by [[Islamic State – Central Africa Province|Islamic State]]-affiliated [[Allied Democratic Forces]] rebels across eight locations in [[Mambasa Territory]], [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-islamic-state-group-mambasa-attack-kidnapping-c1c568db3a670679818aa426cf28fc80 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Three [[Central Reserve Police Force]] personnel are injured after militants open fire on a checkpoint near Mir Bazar in [[Kulgam district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. Security forces launch a search operation to locate the attackers. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/india/india-terrorists-attack-crpf-personnel-in-jk-3-hurt-1.500743618 (''Gulf News'')] [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kulgam-jammu-kashmir-crpf-attack-updates-november-11-2026/article71689037.ece (''The Hindu)'']
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Pakistani Taliban]] carries out an [[ambush]] against [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police]] personnel in [[Kohat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], killing ten officers. Eighteen gunmen are also killed in the ensuing [[shootout]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-militants-attack-kohat-afghanistan-police-ttp-260c8876601c767a4111b17fa9dd255c (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Iran war fuel crisis]], [[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**The [[Germany|German]] [[Merz cabinet|cabinet]] approves draft [[Law of Germany|legislation]] establishing a [[strategic natural gas reserve]] of 24 [[terawatt-hours]], equivalent to approximately 10% of national storage capacity, to maintain [[Energy in Germany|gas supplies]] during emergencies. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261111-germany-to-create-strategic-gas-reserve-to-guard-against-emergencies (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2026 Paraguay banking crisis]]
**The [[Central Bank of Paraguay|Central Bank]] of [[Paraguay]] reports providing partial refunds to 1,812,348 eligible [[Ueno Bank]] [[depositor]]s following the Ueno's collapse. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261112-paraguay-partially-refunds-ueno-bank-depositors-after-collapse (France 24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026–27 European windstorm season]]
**[[Portugal]] closes approximately 8,000 [[Education in Portugal|schools]] nationwide and suspends non-essential public services as [[Storm Charles]] approaches. The second day of the [[Web Summit]] in [[Lisbon]] is also cancelled. [https://apnews.com/article/portugal-storm-charles-wind-rain-schools-462f7dfd9a5abb0ea0a21d5163d49f37 (AP)] [https://deadline.com/2026/11/web-summit-cancels-day-two-as-storm-charles-hits-lisbon-1237220064/ (''Deadline'')]
*[[2026 New York City building collapse]]
**A 3-story apartment building [[2026 New York City building collapse|collapses]] near a construction site in [[Brooklyn]], [[New York City]], [[United States]], killing eight people and wounding 19 more. [https://www.afp.com/en/eight-dead-new-york-building-collapse (AFP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/building-collapse-brooklyn-kills-least-one-injures-10-2026-11-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[Kenya]]n [[Ministry of Health (Kenya)|health ministry]] reports that the country has discharged its last [[Ebola]] patient from a hospital in [[Nairobi]] after eleven contact cases were treated. Kenya will be declared Ebola-free on December 23 if no one else exhibits symptoms. [https://www.dw.com/en/kenya-ebola-free-patient-leaves-hospital/a-79921240 (DW)]
**The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,000, with at least 5,387 deaths, affecting 8 of the country's 26 [[Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|provinces]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/11/ebola-cases-in-dr-congo-pass-11000-with-5387-deaths (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[United States|American]] [[ocean liner]] {{ship|SS|United States||6}} is sunk off the coast of [[Destin, Florida|Destin]]–[[Fort Walton Beach, Florida|Fort Walton Beach]], [[Florida]], United States, to become the world's largest [[artificial reef]]. [https://www.pnj.com/story/news/local/escambia-county/2026/11/11/ss-united-states-sinking-nov-11-timeline-and-where-to-watch/92713208007/ (''Pensacola News Journal'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/famed-ship-heads-afterlife-artificial-reef-deliberate-sinking-off-florida-2026-11-12/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Iran relations]]
**[[Iran]] designates the [[Argentina|Argentinian]] [[Argentine Navy|naval]] and [[Argentine Air Force|air forces]] as [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist organizations]], in response to Argentina designating the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] as such in March. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/11/iran-designates-argentinian-navy-air-force-as-terrorist (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/iran-designates-argentinas-navy-air-force-terrorist-organizations-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[China–Germany relations]]
**Germany announces that [[Bundeswehr|its military]] will discontinue using [[China|Chinese]]-made [[List of unmanned aerial vehicles of China|drones]] for military training and exercises, replacing them with German or other European models to address [[Cyberwarfare and China|security concerns]]. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-military-chinese-drones-replaced-01cc05bde8132f468da742193fcbc489 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/german-military-bans-commercially-available-chinese-drones-spiegel-reports-2026-11-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] bans two [[France|French]] [[National Assembly (France)|lawmakers]], [[Arthur Delaporte]] and [[Sacha Houlié]], and two [[Mass media in France|journalists]], [[Ariane Chemin]] and Paul Gogo, from entering the country for allegedly harassing [[Xenia Fedorova]], the head of [[RT en Français|RT France]], from 2017 to 2023. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/11/russia-bans-two-french-lawmakers-two-journalists-in-tit-for-tat-move (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kenya–Sudan relations]]
**[[Kenya]]n [[President of Kenya|president]] [[William Ruto]] signs a deal for [[Sudan]] to lift its 20-month [[Import quota|ban on imports]] of [[Tea production in Kenya|tea]] from Kenya. [https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/markets/commodities/sudan-lifts-20-month-ban-on-kenyan-tea-after-ruto-deal-5667376 (''Business Daily Africa'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 European infrastructure disruption]]
**[[European bomb threat wave]]
***More than 6,000 [[Education in Italy|schools]] across [[Italy]] are evacuated following [[bomb threats]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-email-bomb-alerts-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Two people are arrested in connection with an explosive attack on the headquarters of [[Colombia]]n broadcaster [[RCN Televisión]] in [[Cali]], [[Valle del Cauca Department|Valle del Cauca]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/colombian-media-outlet-attacked-with-explosives-1.500744157 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]
*Former [[Red Brigades]] member Leonardo Bertulazzi escapes [[house arrest]] in [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]], while awaiting [[extradition]] to [[Italy]] to serve a 27-year prison sentence for kidnapping and membership in an armed group. [[Law enforcement in Argentina|Argentine security forces]] launch a [[Manhunt (law enforcement)|manhunt]] for him. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261111-74-year-old-italian-ex-marxist-escapes-house-arrest-in-argentina (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 United States Senate elections]]
**[[2026 United States Senate election in Mississippi]]
***After a week of counting [[affidavit ballot]]s, the [[Associated Press]] and [[CNN]] project the election to the [[U.S. Senate]] in [[Mississippi]] for [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] candidate [[Scott Colom]], defeating the incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Cindy Hyde-Smith]] and becoming the first [[List of African-American United States senators|black senator]] from the [[U.S. state|state]] since [[Blanche Bruce]] in the [[1874–75 United States Senate elections|1874–75 elections]]. [https://www.afp.com/en/mississippi-democrat-flips-us-senate-seat-stunning-upset (AFP)] [https://apnews.com/live/trump-congress-midterm-elections-politics-news-updates-11-11-2026 (AP)] [https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/politics/live-news/hegseth-impeachment-congress (CNN)]
*[[2026 Brazilian general election]]
**The [[Brazil]]ian [[Superior Electoral Court]] fines [[Meta Platforms]] [[Brazilian real|R$]]7.5 million ([[US$]]1.34 million) for failing to comply with [[Judiciary of Brazil|judicial]] orders concerning the 2026 [[President of Brazil| presidential]] election, while finding insufficient evidence of deliberate [[Foreign electoral intervention|electoral interference]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/11/11/brazil-fines-meta-1-3-million-over-election-controversy_6777388_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[2026 Spanish housing protests]]
**Millions of workers across [[Spain]] launch a [[general strike]] to demand [[Government of Spain|government]] intervention over the country's [[housing crisis]], as an escalation of the [[2026 Spanish housing protests|ongoing protests]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/11/spains-first-general-strike-in-14-years-begins (Al Jazeera)] [https://english.elpais.com/spain/2026-11-11/spains-unions-call-the-first-general-strike-in-14-years.html (''El País'')]
*[[Gibran Rakabuming Raka diploma controversy]]
**[[Indonesia]]n [[Vice President of Indonesia|vice president]] [[Gibran Rakabuming Raka]] submits his resignation amid questions about his educational qualifications. [[Bloomberg News]] reports that [[President of Indonesia|President]] [[Prabowo Subianto]] accepts the resignation, although [[Government of Indonesia|the government]] has not publicly confirmed its acceptance. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesias-vice-president-has-resigned-three-political-sources-say-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Independence March (Poland)|Independence March]]
**[[Poland|Polish]] [[President of Poland|president]] [[Karol Nawrocki]] and at least 500,000 people participate in the annual patriotic march celebrating the [[National Independence Day (Poland)|National Independence Day]] in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]]. [https://zero.pl/news/narodowe-swieto-niepodleglosci-obchody-i-marsz-niepodleglosci (Zero {{small|in Polish}})]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Cyberwarfare by Russia]]
**The [[Romania]]n [[Romanian Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]] (SRI) reports that it stopped a December 2025 [[cyberattack]] against an unidentified [[Government of Romania|government]] institution, attributing it to the [[Russia]]-linked [[Trojan horse (computing)|trojan]] package [[Turla (malware)|Turla]]. The SRI finds no evidence that sensitive information was stolen. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/romanian-intelligence-agency-says-it-identified-russian-linked-cyber-attack-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Cybersecurity]] firm CloudSek reports that the [[Kazakhstan]]-linked [[hacker group]] Silent Lynx used an [[autonomous agent]] to breach [[Tajikistan]]'s [[government database]] and steal more than 2,000 [[State Committee for National Security (Tajikistan)|national security]]-related documents. [https://therecord.media/suspected-kazakhstan-phishing-central-asia-espionage (''The Record'')] [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/kazakhstan-linked-hackers-used-ai-steal-tajik-government-documents-researchers-2026-11-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup]]
**The [[United States men's national under-17 soccer team]] withdraws from the upcoming [[FIFA U-17 World Cup]] in [[Qatar]], citing safety concerns related to the [[Houthi–Saudi conflict]]. [https://www.afp.com/en/us-withdraws-u17-world-cup-qatar-over-security-fears (AFP)] [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50455133/usa-fifa-mens-u17-world-cup-qatar-safety (ESPN)]
